title: Yellow Malt Russian Soya Pilaf
description: A malty, springy, and nutritious Russian-inspired dish featuring soya milk, perfect for meal prep, and aligned with ayurvedic sattvic principles.

ingredients.name: wood-fired baked vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, zucchini, and bell peppers

instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine soya milk, malt syrup, and turmeric, whisking until smooth.
Add the brown rice, yellow split peas, onion, garlic, salt, and black pepper to the bowl, stirring until well combined.
Add the wood-fired baked vegetables to the bowl and stir gently.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh herbs, such as parsley or dill, if desired.
